message: No detected input validation: The code loads images and .mat files directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote fetching and therefore no checksum verification or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code applies only standard augmentation and normalization transforms; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model/train state via load_model_from_train_state and load_train_state without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of the loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code validates class balance, checks expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The analysis.py file performs prototype activation analysis for interpretability, but there is no backdoor/trigger detection, neural-cleanse-style scanning, or gradient anomaly detection in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack generation anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While the dataset uses train/test splits, there is no evidence of hashed/signed evaluation data, cryptographic isolation, or multiple independent metric sources to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection is performed before passing data to the model; inputs are loaded from disk and passed directly.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (logits, distances, attention, activation patterns) are used directly with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based prototype network (PPNet), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
